changes: First release for Digitakt II OS 1.17: in Mute Mode, hold FUNC, choose TRIG tracks and press PERFORM to arm the choice; the mutes switch at the pattern's first step.
Each further PERFORM press waits one more pass of the pattern, up to four; the header shows MUTES ARMED, a loop icon and the passes left.
STOP or leaving Mute Mode drops what is armed.
